1.0.1.en: Added Zigbee Dongle E/P, SNZB-04P, ZBMINI, and SNZB-02LD/WD drivers, plus settings fixes for ZBMINIR2/MINI-ZBD.

1.0.5.en: Availability tracking for mains-powered devices (ZBMINI, ZBMINIR2, MINI-ZB1GP/GSP, SNZB-06P, Zigbee Dongle E/P), with a Traffic and Rejoins overview in the app settings. New devices: MINI-ZB2GS 2-gang switch, SNZB-05P water leak sensor and SNZB-09P siren. SNZB-04P battery reporting and SNZB-06P fixes.

1.0.6.en: Fix icons. Availability tracking for the battery sensors (SNZB-02LD/WD, SNZB-04P/PR2), using each sensor's own heartbeat.

1.0.7.en: Battery sensors: if a SNZB-04P/04PR2 or SNZB-02LD/WD shows as unavailable while idle, remove and re-pair it. MINI-ZB1GP: metering-error and overload alarms. BASICZBR3: availability tracking. Poll Control read is retried when the sensor wakes. Removed the MINI-ZB1GSP, SNZB-05P, SNZB-09P and S60ZBTPF drivers (no hardware to test them).
